open_points.subject: A22 transaction guard policy in generated use-case notes
open_points.text: The guard is behaviour, not data: the notes of every use case state it as prose (SPEC_STANDARD §2) ... No module reads it and no note names it
open_points.question: Must each use-case note state the A22 transaction-guard behaviour, or must notes omit it and leave enforcement solely to the Factory gate?
options: Every use-case note states the guard behaviour without naming rules.transaction_guard_policy
Use-case notes omit the guard policy; only the Factory gate enforces it
open_points.default_guess: Every use-case note states the guard behaviour without naming the rules.transaction_guard_policy key.

open_points.subject: A26 exception payload policy in exception-raising notes
open_points.text: The exception fields are State 6 contracts and the payload rules are prose of the notes that raise each exception (SPEC_STANDARD §2) ... No module reads it and no note names it
open_points.question: Must notes for operations that raise these exceptions state the field-based payload and classification rules, or must those notes omit the policy?
options: Each exception-raising note states the applicable field-based payload rule without naming rules.exception_payload_policy
Exception-raising notes omit the payload policy; the State 6 contracts and Factory gate alone enforce it
open_points.default_guess: Each exception-raising note states the applicable field-based rule without naming the rules.exception_payload_policy key.
